item.title: Fiji Men’s 7s target second win over Australia in Kick On 7s finale
item.description: The Fiji Airways Men’s National 7s side will look to close out the inaugral Kick On 7s with two wins as they prepare to face the Australia Men's 7s in their third game this afternoon. After winning their first game 10-0 before going down 26-14 yesterday, both teams will come out firing at 3pm today as part of the curtain raiser for the Bledisloe Cup.
item.content:encoded:
The Fiji Airways Men’s National 7s side will look to close out the inaugral Kick On 7s with two wins as they prepare to face the Australia Men's 7s in their third game this afternoon.

After winning their first game 10-0 before going down 26-14 yesterday, both teams will come out firing at 3pm today as part of the curtain raiser for the Bledisloe Cup.

In preparation for the Dubai 7s at the end of next month, Coach Osea Kolinisau has picked a mix of seasoned campaigners and is looking to blood new players in this tournament.

In the forwards are Kavekini Tanivanuakula, Wame Ratuva, Vilimoni Raiqiso, Aisake Batikado, Tira Patterson, and Isaia Rugu.

The backs are Iowane Teba, Akuila Dranivotua, Sanaila Daliga, Douglas Daveta, Aquino Savenaca, Saimoni Qeleca and former Fijian Drua player Peni Matawalu.

Fiji will take on Australia 7s at 3pm in their final game.

item.title: Fiji Men's 7s win one and lose one against Australia in Kick On 7s
item.description: Fiji started strongly, edging Australia 10-0 in the opening game before suffering a 26-14 defeat in the second match. Australia bounced back in Game 2, overpowering the Fijian side to level the series at one win each.
item.content:encoded:
Fiji started strongly, edging Australia 10-0 in the opening game before suffering a 26-14 defeat in the second match.

Australia bounced back in Game 2, overpowering the Fijian side to level the series at one win each.

Both teams will meet again at 3pm this afternoon as part of a rugby quadruple-header ahead of the Bledisloe Cup.

The matches are part of both teams' preparations for the HSBC SVNS Series, which kicks off in Dubai on 28 and 29 November.

Meanwhile, the Australian Women's 7s team also recorded a 36-26 victory over New Zealand's Black Ferns 7s.

item.title: Pools confirmed for 2026 Extra Futsal IDC as 8 teams prepare for battle
item.description: Suva, Lami, Labasa and Rakiraki Futsal have been drawn in Pool A, while Pool B features Tailevu Naitasiri, Rewa, Nadi and Ba Futsal. Fiji FA Competitions Manager Shaniya Shankar says the championship marks another important step in the development of futsal in Fiji.
item.content:encoded:
Suva, Lami, Labasa and Rakiraki Futsal have been drawn in Pool A, while Pool B features Tailevu Naitasiri, Rewa, Nadi and Ba Futsal.

Fiji FA Competitions Manager Shaniya Shankar says the championship marks another important step in the development of futsal in Fiji.

She has also thanked Extra Supermarket for its continued support towards the development of futsal and providing opportunities for players and district teams.

Extra Supermarket Chief Marketing Officer Lailanei Burns has reaffirmed the company's commitment to the tournament as its major sponsor for the third consecutive year.

Shankar has wished all eight teams well as they prepare for the championship.

The Championship will be played from Thursday to Sunday at Vodafone Arena in Suva.

item.title: Former Flying Fijians prop Campese Ma'afu joins Fijian Drua as scrum coach
item.description: Former Flying Fijians prop Campese Ma'afu has joined the Swire Shipping Fijian Drua as their scrum coach. He says finally he gets to be onboard with the Fijian Drua and it has been a long time coming
item.content:encoded:
Former Flying Fijians prop Campese Ma'afu has joined the Swire Shipping Fijian Drua as their scrum coach.

He says finally he gets to be onboard with the Fijian Drua and it has been a long time coming

The former prop says he is so excited to be in Fiji with his family, who have come for two weeks to help him set up for the new journey.

Ma'afu who has played 62 Tests for Fiji made his debut in June 2010, where he squared up against older brother Salesi.

The Fijian Drua will take on the Highlanders in their first game on Saturday 13th February, with the venue yet to be confirmed.
